notes:
Did: the pane's Now, Up next and Recent sections are replaced by one bordered Box per area (areas() from snapshot.ts). Each area has a plain Button 'area-<name>' showing '▾/▸ <name>' that toggles it, a progressBar(12) with done/total, and a status word ('◆ building N', 'N need(s) a look', '✓ all work', 'waiting its turn'). openAreasAtom (types: openAreas: Record<string, boolean>, keyed '<loop path>\n<area>') holds explicit toggles; untoggled areas are open while they have running or failing tasks. Open areas list tasks in the order running, failing, ready, waiting, done, each with an icon, its plain sentence and a note (phase, 'trying again', 'not started', 'after <plain of dependency>', finish clock). The stale warning names running tasks by their plain sentence. Removed as unused after the rewrite: snapshot.recent, snapshot.blockedGroups, ItemRow.note (and spend()), ItemRow.title, RunningRow.title, session-log stepStrip/StepState, and the export on STEPS (these files were outside F4's touches, but no other item could be running on them).
Learned: the band (workingOn) still shows '<id> <step>'; F11 changes it. RunningRow worker, seconds and attempt (and the attempts.json read) are kept for F5, whose running task shows how many minutes it has run. Task rows are Text, not Buttons yet: F5 makes them pressable (key them task-<id>). In tests, ui.findAll returns elements in tree order, so findAll with a regex plus .map(e => e.text) checks the row order.
Lesson: [bussin-lean] review flagged ItemRow.note, ItemRow.title and the STEPS export as dead once the Now/Up next/Recent sections went → when a view section goes, grep every snapshot field and helper it read and delete the ones left without a reader in the same change.
